identity: One living YuJian intelligence identity: a transparent lake-water glass sphere with inner refraction, restrained sunlight-gold glints, lake-blue water light and muted aquatic-green ribbons.

asset_roles.idle_button: Frozen Primary Capture Button V1.1; Home and Capture ready state.
asset_roles.activated_button: User Asset 02; transient 0-150ms activated camera-water visual and 150-350ms morph source.
asset_roles.orb_core: Transparent water core; current runtime uses the Main extraction from Asset 03 pending comparison to visual master Asset 01.
asset_roles.motion_reference: Asset 03 informs open front/rear ribbon paths only.

composition.core: Transparent 384x384 runtime core plus native Canvas refraction/highlight overlays.
composition.environment: Page-owned; never baked into reusable Orb core.
composition.camera_core: Separate capture state slot; idle and activated artwork have different asset identities.

color_authority.rule: Reuse the exact current Processing Orb gold, lake-blue and muted-green values from the frozen contract. Do not introduce new global color tokens or silently substitute the generic design-system gold/blue tokens.

rules: One visual identity across page hosts; hosts select states rather than recreating Orb art.
Use localized refraction and glints for life.
Render front and rear ribbons separately.
Gold is restrained, not a full-surface tint.
Use Asset 02 only as the short activated/morph source, not as Home idle artwork.
